summary: You're comfortable in your own skin, and people can feel it.
body: You're comfortable in your own skin, and people can feel it. Your Sun trine Moon means what you want and what you need rarely argue. That's real stability, and it's rarer than you think. The only trap is comfort itself: when peace comes this easily, you can coast right past the experiences that stretch you. Choose growth anyway.
gift: Natural self-acceptance, emotional steadiness, and the ability to move from need into action without fighting yourself first.
shadow: Comfort can become a reason to avoid the experiences that would stretch you.
integration: Let stability support growth instead of replacing it.
do: Trust the steadiness you already have
Choose experiences that stretch without destabilizing you
Use comfort as a base for growth
dont: Avoid challenge only because ease is available
